topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text:
Well, now, this be a peculiar turn of the soil, ain't it? Yon package, wrapped tight as a miser's purse, found its way into my hands, meant for another who once took root in this very spot. I pondered the weight of it, not too heavy, not too light, much like the decisions of a farmer on a cloudy dawn. 

I took the liberty of tying a note to it, asking the sender to send back what they sowed, for I have no use for another's seeds. Mayhaps, the saints watch over our humble paths and guide these misplaced seeds to their rightful home. I’ll rest easy knowing I’ve done what I can, and the earth will still turn, whether or not this package finds its way.
